items.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023
items.q: when Questlove, his bandleader was, you know, in Hollywood being huge

ctx.x: Is it a challenge to gather your A Team for the World’s Most Dangerous Band if you wanted to do a small tour?

Well we did a tour, and Valerie Simpson came out with us as our special guest. Truthfully I never had to tour as opposed to pretty much all my friends. You know I started doing theater and then studio work and television and I find that traveling is just — it doesn’t agree with me. The guys say, “I love the bus.” “Are you crazy?” “No I’d much rather get back on that bus than sleep in a bed.” You know going like that. And then the next morning at 6 AM the sun and you come out of the bus with your costume over your…

I’m going to close with two quotes, this first one is from Eugene Levy a/k/a Johnny Rose from the dream sequence in Schitt’s Creek after you finish the swing version of “Silent Night” and Johnny Rose referring to you said, “He’s worth every penny.”
